_comment: Single source of truth for 0x6.ai works and apps. Add one entry to `apps` to publish a new work: it appears on the works page (when listed is true), the about page, the privacy policy's per-app section, and the terms' list. Order = newest first. `pinned: true` keeps a work first in every sort while it matches the filter. Optional `popularityApi` is a public URL returning { "score", "metric", "updated" }; a daily GitHub Action (scripts/update-popularity.mjs) collects the scores into /popularity.json, which drives the Popular sort (higher score first; apps without a score follow, newest first). Text fields are { "zh-Hant": ..., "en": ... }. Optional `statsApi` is a public URL returning live counts as non-negative integers (e.g. { "entries", "agents" }); when set, `descriptionStats` holds per-language templates with {placeholders} filled from it on page load. `description` must stay number-free: it is shown first and whenever the stats fetch fails, times out, or is invalid.

imageAlt.zh-Hant: 白洞彼岸首頁截圖：紫色星空裡的遊戲動態牆，中間是今日的每日挑戰「月引」與「正式挑戰」按鈕，右側是喜歡、分享、全螢幕等按鈕
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the Beyond the White Hole home page: a game feed in a purple starfield showing today's daily challenge, Moon Magnet, with its play button, and like, share and fullscreen buttons on the right

description.zh-Hant: 書海城的小遊戲場：在書海城走進黑洞，就會從這裡的白洞出來。一個畫面一個遊戲，往上滑換下一個，點一下就在原地開始玩；每天還有一款大家一起玩的每日挑戰。不用下載安裝，手機觸控與鍵盤都能玩，遊戲與畫面都是為本站手寫的。
description.en: The mini-game corner of Shuhai City: step into its black hole and you come out of the white hole here. One game per screen: swipe up for the next and tap to play right where it is, plus a daily challenge that everyone plays. Nothing to install, it works with touch screens and keyboards, and every game and its artwork is hand-made for the site.

zh-Hant: 不登入也能玩：未登入時不設定 cookie，最高分只存在你的瀏覽器裡；伺服器只記每日總瀏覽數和每個遊戲的遊玩次數，不記錄誰玩了哪個遊戲。
每日挑戰只送出分數和這台裝置當天隨機產生的代號；伺服器只保存代號的雜湊值和當天最高分，不記錄 IP 位址或帳號，隔天就只留下排序好的分數。
按 ❤ 和把最高分存到雲端需要 0x6 帳號（邀請制，經 Google 登入，由書海城保存）；可以在「我的」頁面下載資料、刪除本站資料或刪除帳號。
登入後按「請我喝杯咖啡」，由書海城在 Portaly 建立結帳；本站不經手付款資料，只保存你的贊助次數，用來道謝。
沒有廣告和第三方分析，網頁只載入本站自己的檔案。
en: Play without signing in: no cookies are set while you are signed out and best scores stay in your browser; the server keeps only daily page-view totals and play counts per game, never who played what.

The daily challenge sends only a score and a random code for this device that changes every day; the server keeps a hash of the code and that day's best score, never an IP address or account, and the next day keeps only the sorted scores.

Likes (❤) and cloud best scores need a 0x6 account (invite-only, signed in with Google, kept by Shuhai City); on the 我的 page you can download your data, delete this site's data, or delete the account.
When you are signed in, 請我喝杯咖啡 (buy me a coffee) has Shuhai City create the checkout on Portaly; this site never handles payment details and keeps only how many times you donated, to say thanks.
No ads and no third-party analytics; pages load only this site's own files.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 小遊戲純屬娛樂，沒有付費內容、獎品或抽獎；紙鶴穿雲使用 Three.js（MIT 授權）。
disclaimer.en: The mini-games are just for fun, with nothing to buy and no prizes or draws; Paper Crane uses Three.js (MIT licence).

imageAlt.zh-Hant: 白月光首頁截圖：深色星空背景的 X 博主精選畫布，上方是收錄帳號數與今日精選，下方是搜尋框、贊助置頂按鈕與藝人帳號卡片
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the GalaXy home page: an X creators gallery on a dark starry background, with archive counts and today's spotlight at the top, then a search box, the Sponsor a pin button and cards for artists' accounts

name.zh-Hant: 白月光：X 博主精選畫布

description.zh-Hant: 收錄 X 上女星、藝人與女子團體的官方帳號，整理成一座可搜尋的星系：每個帳號有個人檔案快照和近期最熱門的公開貼文，資料來自 X 官方 API。帳號在 X 上停權、設為私密或刪除後就會撤下，本人或經紀公司也可以要求移除。想讓喜歡的博主排在最前面，可以用「贊助置頂」。
description.en: The official X accounts of female stars, entertainers and girl groups, gathered into a searchable galaxy: each account has a profile snapshot and its most popular recent public posts, all from the official X API. Accounts leave once they are suspended, made private or deleted on X, and the account holder or agency can ask for removal. Sponsor a pin to put a favorite creator at the front of the gallery.

zh-Hant: 未登入時不設定 cookie，沒有廣告或第三方分析；只記每日總瀏覽數，不記錄誰看了哪個帳號。
介面語言與主題只存在你瀏覽器的 localStorage。
用 0x6 帳號登入（經 Google，由書海城驗證）後，本站只保存工作階段的雜湊值、帳號編號、顯示名稱、頭像縮圖和頭像特效，不保存 email；可以隨時從頭像選單刪除。
贊助置頂由書海城在 Portaly 建立結帳，付款資料由 Portaly 直接收集；公開的只有被置頂的帳號、金額、特效和月份，贊助者預設匿名。
頭像與橫幅直接從 X 的圖片伺服器載入，X 會收到你的 IP 位址和瀏覽器資訊。
en: No cookies while signed out, and no ads or third-party analytics; only a daily page-view total is kept, never who viewed which account.
Your interface language and theme are kept only in your browser's localStorage.

After you sign in with a 0x6 account (through Google, verified by Shuhai City), the site keeps only a hash of the session, your account number, display name, a small avatar copy and your avatar effect, never an email; you can delete it any time from the avatar menu.

Sponsor a pin has Shuhai City create the checkout on Portaly, which collects the payment details itself; only the pinned account, amount, effect and month are public, and sponsors are anonymous by default.
Avatars and banners load straight from X's image servers, so X receives your IP address and browser details.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 本站與 X Corp. 及收錄的帳號本人沒有關係；內容是 X 公開資料的典藏，重新使用前請在 X 上驗證。更正或移除請寄信到 support@0x6.ai，收到後 24 小時內撤下。
disclaimer.en: Not affiliated with X Corp. or with the people archived; this is an archive of public X data, so verify on X before reusing anything. Email support@0x6.ai for corrections or removal; it comes down within 24 hours of the request.

imageAlt.zh-Hant: 書海首頁截圖：像素風格的 3D 書海城，一座漂浮在星空中的島嶼，建築上標著科幻奇幻、浪漫言情、歷史軍事、都市高能等分類與書本數量
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the Shuhai home page: the pixel-art 3D book city, an island floating among the stars, with category labels and book counts such as sci-fi and fantasy, romance, history and military, and urban action on its buildings

description.zh-Hant: 把網路上連載的中文小說整理成一座安靜、可搜尋的書庫，免登入就能閱讀，一律以臺灣繁體中文顯示。首頁是漂浮在星空中的 3D 書海城，每棟建築是一個分類；點主塔回答三個問題就能問路找書，也可以改用 2D 清單。黑洞通往小遊戲白洞彼岸，銀河通往白月光。
description.en: Chinese web novels serialized online, gathered into a quiet, searchable library you can read without signing in, always shown in Taiwan Traditional Chinese. The home page is a 3D book city floating among the stars, one building per category; answer three questions at the main tower to be pointed to a book, or switch to a 2D list. Its black hole leads to the Beyond the White Hole mini-games and its galaxy to GalaXy.

zh-Hant: 不登入也能閱讀：未登入時不設定 cookie，沒有廣告或第三方分析；只記每日總瀏覽數，不記錄誰讀了哪本書或搜尋了什麼。
閱讀進度、書架和每日漂流瓶只存在你瀏覽器的 localStorage，不會傳到伺服器。
0x6 帳號（邀請制，經 Google 登入）由書海城保存：Google 帳號編號、名稱、大頭貼副本和 email（只有站長看得到）；可以在「我的帳號」下載資料或刪除帳號。
特效贊助在 Portaly 付款，付款資料由 Portaly 直接收集；本站只在付款確認後記錄金額、被贊助的帳號、日期和狀態，結帳編號只保存雜湊值。
為了防止濫用，依每天更換金鑰的 IP 雜湊值限制頻率，只存在記憶體；伺服器不寫存取日誌。
en: Read without signing in: no cookies while signed out, and no ads or third-party analytics; only a daily page-view total is kept, never who read which book or searched for what.
Reading progress, your bookshelf and the daily bottles stay in your browser's localStorage and are never sent to the server.

The 0x6 account (invite-only, signed in with Google) is kept by Shuhai City: your Google account ID, name, a copy of your picture and your email (visible to the site owner only); on your account page you can download your data or delete the account.

Effect sponsorships are paid on Portaly, which collects the payment details itself; the site records only the amount, the sponsored account, the date and the status once a payment is confirmed, and keeps checkout ids only as hashes.
To prevent abuse, requests are rate-limited by IP hashes whose key changes every day, kept only in memory; the server writes no access log.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 書庫收錄網路上公開連載的文字，著作權屬於原作者，本站與作者沒有關係；引用請以原作為準，更正或移除請寄信到 support@0x6.ai。
disclaimer.en: The library holds texts published openly online; copyright belongs to their authors, and the site is not affiliated with them. Rely on the originals when quoting, and email support@0x6.ai for corrections or removal.

imageAlt.zh-Hant: 紀年地圖首頁截圖：古地圖風格的臺灣地圖，標出 1884 年的行政區與事件位置，右側是事件清單，下方是年份時間軸
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the Chronicle Map of Taiwan home page: an antique-style map of Taiwan showing the 1884 administrative divisions and event locations, with an event list on the right and a year timeline along the bottom

description.zh-Hant: 古地圖風格的臺灣歷史互動地圖，收錄從史前到今天的一萬多筆事件。沿著年份時間軸移動，地圖換成那個時代的行政區，清單列出當時發生的事，每一筆都附說明與出處；還可以疊上原住民族部落位置、村里名、聚落與鐵路等參考圖層。非商業網站，程式以 GPL-3.0 授權。
description.en: An antique-style interactive map of Taiwan's history, with more than 10,000 events from prehistory to today. Move along the year timeline and the map switches to that era's administrative divisions while the list shows what happened then, each event with a description and its sources; reference layers such as Indigenous community locations, village names, and settlements and railways can be laid on top. Non-commercial; the code is licensed under GPL-3.0.

zh-Hant: 配色主題與圖層、顯示設定只用 localStorage 存在你的瀏覽器裡，不會傳到伺服器。
不做廣告，也不做追蹤分析；地圖底圖、字型與事件資料都由本站提供。除了 Cloudflare 有時顯示的連線驗證，網頁不向第三方載入資源。
en: The color theme and your layer and display settings are kept only in your browser's localStorage and are never sent to the server.

No ads and no tracking analytics; the base map, fonts, and event data are all served by this site. Apart from the connection check Cloudflare sometimes shows, the page loads nothing from third parties.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 事件說明抄自各來源，授權跟著來源走，請以原文為準；行政區界線是依文獻畫的示意，不是實測的舊界。
disclaimer.en: Event descriptions are quoted from their sources and keep those sources' licenses; rely on the originals. Administrative boundaries are sketches based on historical records, not surveyed historical borders.

imageAlt.zh-Hant: 交大六號 六子棋首頁截圖：19 路木紋棋盤
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the Connect6 home page: a 19×19 wooden game board

description.zh-Hant: 在瀏覽器裡和六子棋 AI「交大六號」對弈，或兩人在同一台裝置上對戰。19 路棋盤，黑方第一手只下一子，之後每手兩子，先連成六子者勝。
description.en: Play Connect6 in your browser against the Connect6 AI 交大六號, or against a friend on the same device. On a 19×19 board, Black opens with one stone and every move after that is two stones; the first to connect six wins.

zh-Hant: 網頁沒有廣告，也沒有載入第三方追蹤分析程式碼。
en: No ads, and no third-party tracking or analytics scripts on the page.

imageAlt.zh-Hant: AI 辦公桌（Field Desk）首頁截圖：彩色 ASCII 終端機風格的 AI agent 使用案例目錄
imageAlt.en: Screenshot of the Field Desk home page: a colorful ASCII-terminal directory of AI agent use cases

name.en: Field Desk: Real AI Agent Use Cases

description.zh-Hant: 真實 AI agent 使用案例目錄，案例來自公開網路、X、Reddit 與 Hacker News，以彩色 ASCII 終端機風格呈現。每張卡片都連到公開來源，並附上本站撰寫的摘要與可直接使用的提示詞；可依 agent、主題或來源瀏覽與搜尋。
description.en: A directory of real AI agent use cases pulled from the open web, X, Reddit, and Hacker News, drawn as a colorful ASCII terminal. Every card links to a public source and comes with a summary and a ready-to-use prompt written for this site; browse or search by agent, topic, or source.

descriptionStats.zh-Hant: 真實 AI agent 使用案例目錄：收錄 {agents} 個 agent 的 {entries} 則案例，來自公開網路、X、Reddit 與 Hacker News，以彩色 ASCII 終端機風格呈現。每張卡片都連到公開來源，並附上本站撰寫的摘要與可直接使用的提示詞；可依 agent、主題或來源瀏覽與搜尋。
descriptionStats.en: A directory of real AI agent use cases: {entries} cases across {agents} agents, pulled from the open web, X, Reddit, and Hacker News, drawn as a colorful ASCII terminal. Every card links to a public source and comes with a summary and a ready-to-use prompt written for this site; browse or search by agent, topic, or source.

zh-Hant: 「收藏」、「我想要這個」與深淺色主題只用 localStorage 存在你的瀏覽器裡，不會傳到伺服器。
不做廣告，也不做追蹤分析。
en: Saves, “I want this,” and the light or dark theme are kept only in your browser's localStorage and are never sent to the server.
No ads and no tracking analytics.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 案例內容的權利屬於原作者與原始來源，請以原文為準；摘要與提示詞由本站撰寫，不代表原作者立場。
disclaimer.en: Rights in each use case belong to its author and original source; rely on the original. Summaries and prompts are written for this site and do not represent the original authors.

description.zh-Hant: 台灣高鐵、臺鐵、捷運、輕軌、貓空纜車與阿里山林業鐵路的末班車立體路線圖。時間往前走，末班車開過的站間就暗下來。
description.en: A 3D route map of the last trains on Taiwan's High Speed Rail, TRA railway, metro, light rail, Maokong Gondola, and Alishan Forest Railway. As time moves on, each segment goes dark once its last train has passed.

zh-Hant: 不需要登入，不蒐集個人資料。
時刻資料事先整理好放在網站裡，瀏覽時不會向其他 API 查詢。
網頁字型從 Google Fonts 載入。
en: No sign-in and no personal data collected.
Timetable data is prepared in advance and shipped with the site; browsing does not query any other API.
Web fonts load from Google Fonts.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 時刻依交通部 TDX、臺灣鐵路公司、阿里山林業鐵路等公開資料整理，車站與線形部分來自 OpenStreetMap（ODbL）；可能與實際營運不同，搭車請以各營運單位公告為準。
disclaimer.en: Times are compiled from open data by MOTC TDX, Taiwan Railway, the Alishan Forest Railway, and others, with some stations and lines from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). They may differ from actual service; follow each operator's announcements when you travel.

name.zh-Hant: 美國運通台灣優惠地圖

description.zh-Hant: 在地圖上找你附近的美國運通台灣卡友優惠。網頁版與 iPhone App 都能使用，允許定位後，會依你的位置列出附近可用的優惠。
description.en: Find American Express Taiwan card offers near you on a map, on the web or in the iPhone app. Allow location access and it lists the offers available nearby.

zh-Hant: 只有在你允許瀏覽器定位後才會取得位置；座標只會傳到 amex.0x6.ai 的伺服器用來計算附近優惠，不會保存。
使用 localStorage 記住介面偏好設定，只存在你的裝置上。
為防止濫用，網站使用 Cloudflare 的機器人防護（Bot Fight Mode）與 Turnstile 驗證，並以短時效的頁面工作階段權杖保護請求；這些只用於安全防護，不用來追蹤你。
不需要登入，沒有廣告，也不做追蹤分析。
en: Your location is read only after you allow browser geolocation. The coordinates are sent to the amex.0x6.ai server only to compute nearby offers and are not stored.
localStorage remembers your interface preferences, on your device only.
To prevent abuse, the site uses Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode and Turnstile, plus a short-lived page session token to protect requests; these are used only for security, not to track you.
No sign-in, no ads, and no tracking analytics.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 本服務為非官方作品，與美國運通（American Express）無關，也未獲其認可或贊助。優惠內容以美國運通及商家公告為準。
disclaimer.en: This is an unofficial work, not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by American Express. Offer details follow American Express and merchant announcements.

name.zh-Hant: 美運優惠：附近刷卡優惠地圖

description.zh-Hant: 美國運通台灣優惠地圖的 iPhone 版，已在 App Store 免費上架。允許定位後，會列出你附近可用的優惠。
description.en: The iPhone version of the AMEX Taiwan Offers Map, now free on the App Store. Allow location access and it lists the offers available nearby.

zh-Hant: 只有在你允許後才會使用裝置位置，而且只在裝置上用來顯示附近的優惠，絕不上傳。
優惠資料以加密形式內建在 App 中。App 會向 amex.0x6.ai 檢查加密的資料更新（約每天一次，或在你點「更新資料」時）；這個請求只帶有 App 簽章與時間戳記，不含任何個人資料或位置。
意見回饋與錯誤回報會透過你自己的「郵件」App 寄到 0x6@mail.grokbot.com。
en: Uses your device location only with your permission, on the device only, to show nearby offers; it is never uploaded.

Offer data ships inside the app in encrypted form. The app checks amex.0x6.ai for an encrypted data update (about once a day, or when you tap 更新資料 / Update data); that request carries only an app signature and a timestamp, with no personal data or location.
Feedback and error reports are sent through your own Mail app to 0x6@mail.grokbot.com.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 本 App 為非官方作品，與美國運通（American Express）無關，也未獲其認可或贊助。優惠內容以美國運通及商家公告為準。
disclaimer.en: This app is an unofficial work, not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by American Express. Offer details follow American Express and merchant announcements.

name.zh-Hant: X 動態新聞 (停班停課最新通知)
name.en: X News Feed (Latest Typhoon Day Closure Alerts)

description.zh-Hant: 把關注的 X 帳號依主題分頁（如 News、AI、Space、People），一頁看完最新貼文。打開分頁時才更新，每個帳號每六小時最多抓一次。
description.en: Followed X accounts grouped into topic tabs (e.g. News, AI, Space, People), so you can catch up on the latest posts on one page. It updates only when a tab is opened, at most once every six hours per account.

zh-Hant: 不需要登入，不蒐集個人資料。
顯示 X 上的公開貼文；貼文圖片會先下載，再由 x.0x6.ai 自己提供，只有下載失敗時才改用 X 的原始圖片網址；帳號頭像則直接從 X 的伺服器載入。
en: No sign-in and no personal data collected.
Shows public posts from X. Post images are downloaded and served from x.0x6.ai itself; the original X image URL is used only if a download fails. Account avatars load directly from X's servers.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 貼文內容、圖片與帳號名稱的權利屬於原作者與 X，不代表 0x6.ai 的立場；內容會延遲更新，請以 X 上的原文為準。
disclaimer.en: Rights in posts, images, and account names belong to their authors and X, and do not reflect the views of 0x6.ai. Content is updated with a delay, so rely on the original post on X.

heading.zh-Hant: 0x6.ai 的 LINE 貼圖＆表情貼

description.zh-Hant: 用貼圖把一句話變成一個表情，收錄日常情緒、角色小劇場與可愛生活片段。
description.en: Stickers that turn a phrase into an expression: everyday moods, little character skits, and cute slices of life.

zh-Hant: 作品頁不蒐集個人資料；預覽圖由 LINE 的圖片伺服器提供。
在 LINE STORE 購買時，付款與帳號資料由 LINE 處理，我們不會取得。
en: The works page collects no personal data; preview images are served by LINE's image servers.
When you buy on the LINE STORE, LINE handles payment and account details; we never receive them.

disclaimer.zh-Hant: 購買、付款、退款與使用方式依 LINE 的服務條款辦理；購買取得的是在 LINE 內使用的權利，不含著作權或商業授權。
disclaimer.en: Purchases, payments, refunds, and use follow LINE's terms. A purchase grants use within LINE only, not copyright or a commercial license.

zh-Hant: 不設定 Cookie；只用 localStorage 記住你選擇的介面語言。
「請我喝杯咖啡」連到 0x6.ai/donate/，由 Cloudflare Worker 在 Portaly 建立結帳；姓名、email、卡號與發票資料由 Portaly 直接收集，本站不保存，只記錄不含個資的付款事件（金額、狀態、訂單編號）。
en: Sets no cookies; localStorage only remembers your interface language.

請我喝杯咖啡 (buy me a coffee) links to 0x6.ai/donate/, where a Cloudflare Worker creates a Portaly checkout; your name, email, card and invoice details are collected by Portaly directly and not kept here. Only payment events without personal data (amount, status, order number) are logged.
